title: From generalized Poincaré to Poincaré-Sobolev inequalities via self-improving methods
summary: We establish several improvements to the main results of [PR19] and [CP21], refining the seminal self-improving method for generalized Poincaré inequalities from [FPW98, MP98]. These results, together with various related applications, stem from a general self-improving property for functions satisfying the local inequality $$\frac{1}{|Q|}\int_Q |f(x)-f_Q|\,dx \le a(Q)$$ for all cubes $Q\subset\mathbb{R}^n$.
